title: Crabbin House South | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked away in the serene Lake District of WaterColor, this custom-built, designer-inspired vacation home is a haven of privacy and luxury, backing onto a lush wooded preserve. Ideal for families seeking both comfort and style, the residence boasts an open-concept living area furnished in coastal blues and vibrant greens, reflecting the tranquility of its surroundings. The heart of the home is a chef’s dream kitchen equipped with high-end Thermador appliances and an expansive farmhouse table for eight, perfect for gathering delicious meals. Further enhancing the ground floor is a screened porch, offering a secluded spot to enjoy morning coffee or unwind in the evening, alongside a cozy guest bedroom complete with a private bath.
